meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问打磨方案并自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中完善设计并同步产出文档
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to refine designs through discussion and produce docs simultaneously

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动一个名为“grilling”的面试式对话，通过不断追问来帮你完善计划或设计，并同时生成架构决策记录和术语表。
howto.when: 当你输入命令 `/grilling` 时触发，该技能会调用 `/domain-modeling` 技能来执行。

say.text: 开始一个 grilling 会话，帮我完善这个设计方案。
say.note: Claude 会启动面试式追问，并生成 ADR 和术语表。

say.text: 用 grilling 模式审查我的项目计划。
say.note: Claude 会通过提问帮你发现计划中的漏洞。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will start a "grilling" interview-style conversation that relentlessly questions you to sharpen a plan or design, while simultaneously creating Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and a glossary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type the command `/grilling`. It invokes the `/domain-modeling` skill to run the session.

say_en.text: Start a grilling session to refine this design proposal.
say_en.note: Claude will begin an interview-style questioning and generate ADRs and glossary.

say_en.text: Use grilling mode to review my project plan.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions to uncover gaps in your plan.
